description: Table of contents for one book: ordered chapters with their real titles. When to use: right after cyberlibrary_book_meta, to pick which chapter to read; this is the cheapest way to survey a long book (single HTML read regardless of chapter count). Do not use: to read prose (call cyberlibrary_get_chapter). Returns: {lang, slug, total_chapters, page, total_pages, chapters[{chapter, title, url}]}.

page.description: 1-based page of the chapter list. Default 1.

name: cyberlibrary_get_toc
title: Cyberlibrary Get Toc
